verdict.rationale: Modal is a serverless compute and infrastructure platform, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role outside its category. The only agent-related evidence is a skill that helps external coding agents use Modal, which points the other way and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
